text:
Ivy: Capture from ClearWave onboarding: two asks that matter for renewal in ~6w — (1) one-click CSV showing per-route token usage with dollar cost columns for FP&A, (2) ability to silence low-priority alerts during business hours.
Noah: Do we have an exact CSV sample?
Ivy: Yes, they sent a layout. Quote: 'Our FP&A needs a single export; otherwise it's manual reconciliation.'
Sam: Renewal-risk flagged. Suggest ship small-metric export now + cost column later.
Ravi: Dev estimates: interim export (route + token counts) + download button ~2w if aggregations exist; full cost attribution ~4-6w. Alert snooze (org quiet hours) behind FF ~1w.
Ivy: ClearWave volunteered to be beta for the full cost export if we provide interim CSV now.
product-bot: Created productboard entry PB-5998 "ClearWave per-route export + alert-snooze".
Sam: Actions: 1) Ravi confirm technical dependency and ETA in 48h, 2) Ivy upload CSV sample and confirm beta, 3) Sam add renewal flag in PB item. Check-in in 3 days.
Ravi: Will post blockers in 24h.
Noah: Thanks, team — keep this high touch."
